description: SEC 10-K executive officers — Executive officers of a US public company from its latest 10-K (the Information about our Executive Officers section): name, age, position, first year in role (since), short bio and prior roles, role tags (CEO/CFO/COO/General Counsel/CTO/Chair), average age and age range, median tenure, key-role map and governance flags (CEO also Chair, no CFO listed, officer 70+, new appointment). Returns CROSS_REFERENCED with the quote when the company only lists officers in its proxy statement. ticker required; optional filing=1 for the prior 10-K. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_executive_officers
